newsitem.title: USA: Endosonics names Salquist board chairman.
newsitem.headline: Endosonics names Salquist board chairman.

text.p: EndoSonics Corp said it named Roger Salquist as its new chairman of the board of directors.

Salquist will replace Michael Henson, EndoSonics chief executive from 1988 through 1995 and chairman of the board of directors since 1993. Henson will continue as a board member and also serves as chairman, CEO and president of Cardiovascular Dynamics Inc, 46 percent owned by EndoSonics.
Salquist currently serves as a director of and consultant to Calgene Inc, after serving as chairman and chief executive officer from 1984 through 1996.
